Oneliner

Amateur radio missions with transponders and telemetry downlinks.

Description

Amateur radio missions. The amateur communications payload consists of U/V 20 kHz wide transponders with 145 MHz CW beacon and 19k2 GMSK AX25 telemetry downlinks.
Notes

116 mm × 116 mm × 116 mm cubic body, but maybe still CubeSats. May be some mix-up between object names and NORAD IDs with 40900 between Space-Track and Jonathan McDowell.
